records.title: docs(proposals): define the check-artifact reuse contract
records.release_claim: explicit reusable analysis artifacts preserve full fidelity and fail closed on stale input identity
records.reason: This contract is the prerequisite for #2250. It ships only if the implementation is selected; otherwise both may defer together without leaving a public half-contract.
records.non_claim: Ordinary check JSON is not a reusable analysis artifact, and no implicit cross-invocation cache is introduced.
